title: BSG Forecasting — Automated Business Strategy Game
description: Two-stack ML + RPA automation for the McGraw-Hill Business Strategy Game capstone. Python neural net layer (GradientBoosting + RandomForest + MLP, with scipy.optimize.differential_evolution for combinatorial decision search) generates optimal moves; a TypeScript + Playwright layer logs into bsg-online.com and drives the live game UI.
role: Solo developer of the ML + RPA automation; Team Lead of a 4-person company in the simulation.
technologies: Python, scikit-learn, scipy, TypeScript, Playwright, Vitest, Node.js
results: Invited to the BSI conference as one of the top 100 teams worldwide (out of 3,700+). Industry 26: rose from #8 to #1, $1.507B cumulative profit, EPS $16.49 vs $7.00 target.
